en: Guide
The Trainers up on the platforms hold the Dragon types in their hands. Take the corridor and let the statues' heads carry you up.
Dragon Pokémon fear Ice, Dragon and Fairy moves above all.
Welcome to the Opelucid City Pokémon Gym! Here, have some Fresh Water. Stay hydrated!
Did you see the dragon statues? This is the only Gym in Unova with statues this size! Climb up and you'll see why Drayden loves it.
You defeated the Gym Leader! Congratulations! The two dragon statues side by side looked just like the old legend, didn't they?
Ron
Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight! Trainers far stronger than I wait for you above.
You're strong enough to challenge Mayor Drayden. You have the power to unleash the full force of your deep desire to win!
Always aim for the top, like a dragon taking flight!
Denae
Defense is everything! The Trainers above me have different ways of fighting; some fight only in threes, and some only in rotation.
A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! You must desire victory more than anything. Now, go!
Defense is everything! ...And you got past mine.
Rhona
Offense is everything! As for the Trainers above me, bring three healthy Pokémon if you mean to face them.
A battle between you and Mayor Drayden must be stirring! Now, go!
Offense is everything, and yours was more than mine.
Jerry
If you want to battle me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a triple battle, three Pokémon fight side by side and their power adds up.
Three at once! A combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power. And still you won.
Triple battles are a combination that raises three Pokémon's destructive power!
Lucius
If you plan on battling with me, bring three or more healthy Pokémon with you! In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.
You must desire victory more than anything. Go on, face the mayor!
In a rotation battle, how the three Pokémon follow one another is the key.
Drayden
Welcome. Thank you for coming. I am Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City.
As its mayor, I have given everything to developing this city. And as a Trainer, I have never stopped training.
Now! Show me what you have. Show me the full force of your bond with your Pokémon!
Wonderful. I'm grateful that we had a chance to meet and battle. It reminded me that Pokémon battles are about working with others, whether Pokémon or people.
Here, take this. It is the Legend Badge, proof that you have beaten me.
{player} received the Legend Badge from Drayden!
Well, now. You have obtained seven of Unova's Gym Badges. Take this too, so that you remember how a dragon fights.
A move should be understood before it is used, and used only when it is needed. That is the whole of a dragon's wisdom.
Professor Juniper asked me to tell you about the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon that created Unova. Please come to my house, the building on the street below, and I will tell you the story.
It is not the passage of time that causes Pokémon and people to age.
When the energy that flows in their hearts dries up, that is when they grow old. Remember it.
You forgot your TM, I see. Here it is.
